Comment: ReciterAI new-researcher onboarding workflow (#80 Phase 2). Operator-triggered per CWID via aws stepfunctions start-execution with input {"cwid": "...", "allow_cost_override": false}. Orchestrate scopes the CWID's full accepted-publication set, culls the PROCESSING# checkpoint, and applies the cost guard; CheckProceed routes skipped/cost_exceeded to a known-status terminal writer or ready into the Enrich->Score cascade. Enrich runs synopsis + impact (run_enrichment_backfill) for the CWID's PMID set so Score finds a synopsis for each — onboarding generates synopses inline (#112) and the synopsis-precondition deferred check is retired. Mirrors the hot path's shape: per-stage STAGE# rows written by the dynamodb:putItem SDK integration (D-07 crash-safety), handlers return DDB-typed envelopes, every Lambda Task Catches States.ALL to WriteOnboardingFailed. AssignFanOut is a per-topic Step Functions Map (PR 4): DeriveDirtyTopics groups the CWID's TOPIC# rows by topic, CheckAssignTopics routes an empty set past the Map, and the Map runs the reused assign Lambda once per topic that has an approved hierarchy draft. No concurrency lock and no states:* calls — onboarding is operator-triggered per CWID and same-CWID races are absorbed by per-stage idempotency.

CheckProceed.Comment: Routes the orchestrator's routing status. ready -> the Enrich->Score cascade; skipped / cost_exceeded -> a known-status terminal writer.

WriteOnboardingSkipped.Comment: Inline putItem of the pre-typed skipped row. skipped is an idempotent no-op — silent, no operator notification.

WriteOnboardingCostExceeded.Comment: Inline putItem of the pre-typed cost-guard terminal — status=failed, error_code=CostGuardExceeded (D-COSTSTATUS).

Enrich.Comment: Onboarding enrich stage (#80 / #112). reciterai-onboarding-enrich runs run_enrichment_backfill — synopsis + impact for the CWID's PMID set — so Score finds a synopsis for each. Idempotent + partial-tolerant: a per-PMID enrichment failure does not abort the cascade; only a Lambda-level exception Catches to WriteOnboardingFailed. Replaces the retired synopsis-precondition deferred check.

Score.Comment: Reused hot Lambda reciterai-hot-score; the {pmids} event routes to score_publications --pmids (PR 1).

DeriveDirtyTopics.Comment: PR 4. Groups the CWID's TOPIC# activity rows (FacultyIndex GSI) by topic, restricted to the run's PMID set, dropping topics with no approved hierarchy draft. Produces the assign_topics array AssignFanOut's Map iterates and the assign_input_hash BuildAssignSummary stamps on the assign-stage row.

CheckAssignTopics.Comment: Empty dirty-topic set -> AssignSkipped; mirrors the hot ASL's CheckAssignNeeded so a CWID with no draft-covered topic activity does not enter an empty Map.

AssignSkipped.Comment: No dirty topics with an approved draft — inject a typed skipped assign envelope so Finalize reads $.assign_envelope.input_hash.S exactly as for a real fan-out.

skip_reason.S: onboarding run produced no dirty topics with an approved hierarchy draft

AssignFanOut.Comment: PR 4 per-topic fan-out. One iteration per dirty topic: AssignOne runs the reused reciterai-hot-assign Lambda for that topic's PMIDs, then WriteAssignStageRowOne writes that topic's STAGE#assign_subtopics#topic row. The N per-topic rows are the assign-stage audit trail; BuildAssignSummary then synthesizes the single envelope Finalize reads. MaxConcurrency bounds concurrent Bedrock + DynamoDB load.

AssignOne.Comment: Reused hot Lambda reciterai-hot-assign; its {topic_id, delta_pmids} event contract is exactly the Map item, so the handler is reused unchanged.

WriteAssignStageRowOne.Comment: Per-topic STAGE#assign_subtopics#topic:{topic} row, written inside the iteration so each topic's audit row lands as its assign completes (D-07 crash-safety).

BuildAssignSummary.Comment: Synthesizes the single $.assign_envelope Finalize reads (input_hash -> stage_input_hashes.assign). The real per-topic detail is the N STAGE#assign_subtopics#topic rows the Map wrote; topic_count is States.ArrayLength of the Map output.

TopTopic.Comment: Reused hot Lambda reciterai-hot-top-topic; takes a plain PMID list, reused unchanged.

Rollup.Comment: Reused hot Lambda reciterai-hot-rollup; the {cwid} event routes to the PMID-aware rollup_by_cwid --cwid path (PR 2 / #90).

Finalize.Comment: Decides the workflow terminal status complete|partial from the PROCESSING# checkpoint and returns the DDB-typed STAGE#onboarding#cwid row for WriteOnboardingFinal.

WriteOnboardingFinal.Comment: Inline putItem of finalize's complete|partial STAGE#onboarding#cwid row.

WriteOnboardingFailed.Comment: Catch target for every Lambda Task. Builds the failed STAGE#onboarding#cwid row inline from the original execution input ($.cwid survives Orchestrate's ResultPath) and the Catch payload — the orchestrator's pre-typed envelope is unavailable when Orchestrate itself crashed. The optimized DynamoDB integration auto-types bare string values; the Map Catch payload is JSON-stringified into one S attribute.
